newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices fall, market sentiment low.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices fall, market sentiment low.

text.p: Indian cotton prices fell on Thursday on subdued market sentiment, dealers said.
Mill buying was sluggish while rising new crop arrivals dragged prices down.
"The absence of any announcement so far on fresh export quotas by the government also subdued the market sentiments," one broker said.

In the spot deals Bengal-deshi slid by 5/10 rupees to 765/815 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while F-414 fell by 35/55 rupees to 1,770/1,795 rupees. Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 100 rupees to 11,400/11,600 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while forward delivery was quoted lower at 11,200/11,300 rupees per candy.
